title: When an individual may not serve as a committee officer.
bodyText: No candidate committee or noncandidate committee that supports or opposes a candidate shall have an officer who serves as an officer on any other candidate committee or noncandidate committee that supports or opposes the same candidate.
bodyHtml: [§11-325]  When an individual may not serve as a committee officer.  No candidate committee or noncandidate committee that supports or opposes a candidate shall have an officer who serves as an officer on any other candidate committee or noncandidate committee that supports or opposes the same candidate. [L 2010, c 211, pt of §2]
